title: Baby, Take a Bow
description: Eddie Ellison is an ex-con who spent time in Sing-Sing prison. Kay marries him as soon as he serves his time. Five years later, Eddie and his ex-convict buddy Larry, have both gone straight, and Eddie and Kay have a beautiful little daughter named Shirley. However, Welch has kept a close eye on them for years. He believes in "once a criminal, always a criminal." When Eddie's employer's wife's pearls go missing, it comes out that Eddie and Larry both spent time in prison, and they're fired. Welch suspects that Eddie and Larry have something to do with the theft of the pearls. Will Welch prove that Eddie and Larry had something to do with the theft, or will the truth prevail?

title: VICE GANDA enjoy sa kulitan with P-POP groups LARO LARO PICK It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: In their P-POP era? ANNE CURTIS, KIM CHIU bumuo ng girl group!
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: Miss Q&A Jeraldine & Franco
description:
Inabangan ng sangkabaklaan ang harapan ng mga beki na mahusay sa talakan. Mula Lunes hanggang Biyernes sa “It’s Showtime,” sinala ang mga kandidata sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan, at sa araw na 'to, Sabado, nagkaalaman na kung sino sa limang weekly finalists ang best.

Chukchak mode on sina Ivern Doroteo, Ringo Antonio, Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, Franco Gray, at Billy Labitan Yadao. Bago ang talak, sunod-sunod agad ang patutsada ng mga baklang 'di pakakabog sa isa't isa. At sino itong kandidata na tila ba napagtulungan ng mga kasamahan?

Mula lima, apat ang pumaslak sa Wit Lang round. Mga tanong dito, hindi naman kailangan dibdibin, mas okay kung sasakyan ang 'amats' at lalaruin. At ang Top 2 wittiest candidates of them all, sina Billy at Ringo, umabante sa next round na Beklamation.

Umugong ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena! Umugong din ang pag-asa para sa players na mula sa Brgy. Ugong, Pasig City. Sino kaya ang makakatawid hanggang jackpot round, at makakapag-uwi ng POT money na P300,000?

Fresh frm breakup pa si Sharmy nang maki-join sa kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick. Naikuwento rin niya kung bakit sila naghiwalay ni ex. At ang dahilan? Girl best friend! Kaya sina Anne Curtis at ibang hosts ay napaisip, red flag ba ang isang taong committed na pero super close at minsan nag-a-"I love you" kay best?

Umabante sa jackpot round ang mapagmahal na asawa at ama na si Kokey. Eh di isama na 'yan sa Team Loyal a.k.a. ang samahan ng mga takot sa asawa!

title: Miss Q&A, naging 'PISIKALAN'?
description:
Over the moon ang saya sa pagbisita ni “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” pride Carmelle Collado, fresh from her recent Eurovision Asia journey. Napili ang kantang in-interpret ni Carmelle, "Sobra-Sobra," bilang entry ng Pilipinas sa unang Eurovision Song Contest Asia.

At siyempre, kumpleto ang September 1 dahil hindi lang basta sumilip kundi live na live ang Chan-ta ng Pinas, Jose Mari Chan. Nagkatotoo ang 'memes' nang personal niyang dalhin ang Christmas feels sa “It’s Showtime.”

Wish upon a star, mga kandidata, wit at confidence nila ay on full display. Sina Ringo Antonio, Gina Ganda, at Franco Gray ang nagpakitang-gilas sa “It’s Showtime” today.

Ang trip nila, sumabak sa sayawan. May bonus performance pa si Franco, na inilabas ang kanyang action-star moves a la Coco. Pero kung hataw na hataw sila sa dance floor, medyo napaisip naman ang ating queens pagdating sa tanungan sa “Tumpak Ganern.”

Ang Wit Lang, naging exciting dahil sa face-off nina Franco at Ringo. Napunta kay Franco ang tanong na, “Bakit pa tinatawag na rush hour kung hindi naman umaandar ang traffic?” Samantala, napaisip si Ringo kung maninigarilyo pa ba ang kapre kahit may hika ito.

Habang binibilang ang mga araw bago dumating ang Christmas bonus, sa "It's Showtime" muna makilaro. Malay mo, may naghihintay na aguinaldo. Swerte kaya ay dumating nang big para sa mga taga-Lower Bicutan, Taguig.

Kilig ang regalo nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto. Si Darren, hindi makatingin nang diretso sa ka-eksena, kaya tumawag ng 'take two' si Vice Ganda. Hirit naman ni Kim Chiu, baka hindi makatingin kasi may "feelings" na?!

Ginalingan ni massage therapist Roy sa mga challenges kaya siya ang nakakuha ng spot sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P100,000 ang naghihintay. Para sa anak na nasa autism spectrum, pinili niyang lakasan ang loob at sunggaban ang pagkakataon.

title: Ms. Castro umupo bilang Miss Q&A hurado
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, hinalikan ni Jhong
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

description: An idyllic cabin, secluded near a mountain lake, becomes the scene of unspeakable violence as psychotic brothers terrorize a group of campers. When the blood clears, one camper survives -- but her escape is hindered by a devastating car crash, leaving her comatose. When she wakes, her memory is gone, but her desire for revenge is strong and needs satisfying. But it's only when she returns to the scene of the massacre that she ultimately learns the truth from that terrible night.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A Kishan, nag-sample ng burlesque dancing
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A KULOT, game sa 'pampe-playtime' ni Meme Vice
description:
Tayo'y always napapalingon sa kanyang mapulang blush, ang awrahan ni Sasa Gurl for today's video, deserve ng sash. Best in Costume 'yan? Ang Halloween, parang dumating in advance.

Humagupit na sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang bumabagyong kagandahan at wit ng mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A."

Kung costume party ito, effortless si Miss Q&A Kulot ng Cavite, ang 'bunot' ni Vice Ganda for today. Pinag-sample ng gymnastics at pinakanta, pero ang hindi niya naipakita ay 'yung talent na kumagat ng bakal. Isa pang talent niya ay pasayahin ang Madlang People sa charisma niyang kamahal-mahal.

Umuwi man siyang 'lotlot' sa kompetisyon, nasungkit naman niya ang puso ng buong nation. Samantala, sina Chloe Castillo ng Isabela at Rhed Sicuan ng Las Pinas ang umabante sa Wit Lang round kung saan tuluyan nilang pinakawalan ang fierce na skill sa talakan.

Para kina hurado Max Collins, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves, mas matimbang ang bilang ng sagot ni Rhed. Siya ang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Susuyuin ng mga taga-Manuyo Dos, Las Pinas ang swerte upang masungkit nila ang Laro Laro Pick POT money sa “It’s Showtime” July 9 episode.

Enjoy ang hosts sa chikahan with Tin, na pangarap maging pulis noong kabataan pero ngayon makeup na ang kanyang fantasy. Kakaiba naman ang nickname ni Meow, ang solo parent na raketera queen.

Dumating naman sina Senyora Angelika (Jhong Hilario) at Inocencia (MC) upang makipagsundo kay Memerimar. Pero ang batian, nauwi sa bugbugan!

Sa jackpot round, mabilisan ang naging tawaran nang tanggapin agad ni Lenlen ang Li-Pot offer na P30,000. Malaking tulong na kasi ito pra sa therapy ng anak niyang nasa autism spectrum.

title: Dot-t
description: A deadly meteor strike on a planet in the distant galaxies brings destruction and the desperate escape of a young extraterrestrial in a space pod - and is forever separated from her mother and father. On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

title: U Turn [Hindi]
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

title: Vjerujem u andjele
description: The mailman, Sime, is one of the favorite people of a small town, on an island in the middle of the sea. Sime is very intelligent and the locals have high regards for him because he is unusually well versed in all the events and destinies in the small town. He knows the weather forecast, what winds will blow, what the sermon on the Sunday mass will be. For all the locals Sime is an untouchable genius. However, unlike the locals, the viewers soon find out that the Sime's ingenuity is based on his reading of the mail. Fascinated by other people's destinies, Sime has perfected a way for opening letters and keeping complete records on the people living on the island. He keeps a precise track of who gets what kinds of letters, and that gives him insight into discrete and private affairs of people. One day a beautiful woman named Dea moves into town, and all the men try and court her. However, Dea is keeping some kind of a secret and she completely ignores all their attempts, also charming attempts by the mailman Sime. Suddenly, by chain of events, she completely by accident finds out about the mailman's "hobby" i.e. that he reads other people's mails. At that time she herself starts receiving letters from a mysterious Klara who she starts an intensive correspondence with. The mailman, naturally, reads Dea's mails and he's putting the "puzzle" of her life together. He plans a courtship based on the things he finds out about her. He likes Dea very much so he gives his best to win her over (naturally, he does it by using privileged information he acquires by reading her letters). After a short time Dea "falls" for his charms and everything seems idyllic. However with time, town's people turn against Sime claiming that Dea "stole him away". Sime is not concerned about it because the more time he spends with Dea the more he likes her. However what is Dea really like?

title: Noc u kuci moje majke

title: U reki
description: At the River is about a day in the life of an 84-year old mother and her 60-year old daughter who have already reached a stage in life where their age difference is barely noticeable. One day the two are visited by a young official who quite unwittingly makes the mother feel young again and, so, she decides to set out for a walk by the river together with her daughter. It becomes increasingly clear to both of them that the best days of their lives are past and that they make a ludicrous impression wherever they go. However, they somehow keep their spirits up and try to enjoy this last walk together. They both know that this is the very last of the 'grand days' of their lives.

title: Happy 10th anniversary, Showtime Online U!
description:
Anuman ang status ng 'yong puso, saktong-sakto ang happiness at good vibes na hatid ng "Showtime Online U" squad na nagse-celebrate ng 10th anniversary.

PaLOVEan sa rampahan at talakan sina Miss Q and A candidates Callout Everdean, Adam Lambert, at Cali Serion.

Feeling reyna agad si Callout dahil sa winner niyang love life. Ipinakilala ng kandidata ang kanyang American husband. Ibang mukha ng pag-ibig naman ang ipinakita ni Adam, na focused muna sa career dahil na-trauma sa past relationship. Si Cali naman na isang iskolar ng bayan, pag-ibig ng ina ang inaasam.

Dahil napag-uusapan na ang pag-ibig, naisip ni Vice na alamin ang love status ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Na-intriga ang Madlang People sa mga status nina Kim Chiu, Darren Espanto, at Jackie Gonzaga. Pero ang status na pinakatumagos sa puso ng hosts at Madlang People, 'yung sinabi ni Ryan Bang, "Nadurog parang paminta. Pero may bubuo. Sino kaya?"

Agad nakapasok ang University of the Philippines student na si Cali sa Wit Lang round, kung saan ibinuhos niya ang puso sa tanong na, "Ano ang gagawin mo kung sa sobrang bait mo handa ka nang kunin ni Lord?" In-enjoy naman ni Adam ang talak sa tanong na, "Ano ang nararamdaman ng valid ID na laging dalawa silang hinahanap?"

Dahil sumilip na ang Haring Araw, extra sunny at bubbly ang mood ng mga taga-Malinta, Valenzuela na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Angel, isang masipag na nanay. Sa kanilang usapan, napa-isip si Vice Ganda sa pagkakaiba ng bawat henerasyon. Kaya nga ba minsan 'magulo' ang mundo dahil sa pagsasama-sama ng iba't ibang henerasyon?

Samantala, nakaka-Gen Z ang kilig na hatid nina Darren at Jackie sa isang eksena. Aba, si Darren, nagpapalambing na! Panindigan n'yo kilig namin!

Sumikat ang swerte kay JM matapos niyang malampasan ang lahat ng challenges. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer at sinubukan pa ni Kim na kumbinsihin si JM na tanggapin ito. Pero hindi nagpatinag si JM at sinugalan ang POT question. Magtagumpay kaya si JM at maiuwi ang P300,000 POT money?

title: W
description: A freshman in university, Neung, finds the entire college experience a challenge. She has never lived away from home before, and making new friends has never been easy. Along the way, she manages to find a companion in the cheerful Ploy, and even develops a love interest in department senior Ton.

title: W
description: Katie Lewis and her husband Ben discover that they are the targets of a mysterious killer who leaves the letter W at the scene of their near-fatal "accidents." While trying to avoid death, the couple must struggle to discover the source of these attacks.

title: W
description:
W - If Woman is one of the words which comes to your mind, this movie is for you!

Open-minded, ambitious Sandhya Singh a.k.a Sandy (Leeza Mangaldas); Traditional, romantic Roohi Malik (Lezlie Tripathy) and Rebellious, lesbian (gay) Manu (Sonal Giani) are musicians & best friends forever (BFF) who run an event management company called W.

Short of funds and racing against time on their journey to organize their biggest music event yet The Freedom Concert they unexpectedly encounter The introvert, fanatic Abhay a.k,a. Bhaiji (Raaj Singh Arora); Mentally unstable Dhruv (Danish Pandor) & Womanizer Chotu (Abhay Attri). Although of good social standing, these men have issues with urbanization & modernity!

Not a battle of fists, W comes as a contemporary youthful musical thriller which explores the clash between the Women of Today and Men of Yesterday and how each side justifies their actions, words and mindset while setting an example for the rest of us without being preachy.

title: W imieniu diabla
description: Sisters, convinced of the teachings of Father Francis, cut off from the outside world and changing the way we profess their faith.

title: Aarous w Aaris
description: As he looks for a suitable bride, Nassim returns to Lebanon where he enlists the help of matchmaking service. But he finds himself falling for Noura, the service's manager.

title: W-tyyli
description: Documentary about the making of a talk show that doesn't even exist.

title: Kamen Rider W Returns: Kamen Rider Eternal
description: Follows the story of Daido Katsumi, the formation of NEVER, the mission that led them to target Fuuto, and reveals just how Daido obtained his Lost Driver and got his first taste of the power of Kamen Rider Eternal.

title: W. House
description: Interconnected tales highlighting the ugliness lying at the core of the shiny lights of an urban corporate culture in an Indian Metropolitan. With a mystery at its core, it's a character study of several facades of human nature.

title: Short w Fanelah w Cap
description: Three friends who work in Sharm El-Sheikh, each with their own story. One of them helps the daughter of an Arab minister to escape from her father, who refuses her marriage to the one she loves. Events intertwine after she escaped and discovered the truth about her loved one.

title: Rabiye Kurnaz vs. George W. Bush
description: Desperate to help her son, Rabiye Kurnaz, a housewife and loving mother from Bremen, goes to the police, notifies authorities and almost despairs at their impotence and in the end, against all the odds, something truly remarkable happens.

title: Harag W' Marag
description: This is the story of lost love in a controversial setting. Manal, Zaki and Mounir are in there twenties, living in a confined community where basic needs are met yet chaos and disorder brew. The two boys are in love with the same girl who finds herself being the bet for a football match between them; the winner marries Manal. This story reflects a football and play-station youth and how they deal with their emotions in a community that is increasingly closed off and isolated.

title: Bhikhari Boss
description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

title: Golden Boy Ki Love Story
description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.

title: Fake Doctor
description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

title: King's Killer Comeback
description: Yeh high-voltage revenge drama class divide, fake identity aur betrayal par based hai, jiska core theme hai “Perception vs Reality.” Adhiraj, ek billionaire mafia king, apni identity chhupakar jeeta hai, jabki uski wife Aviva usse dhokha dekar uski power ka misuse karti hai. Shaadi ka setup ego clashes aur hidden truths ka battlefield ban jaata hai, jahan har episode ke saath tension aur stakes badhte hain. yeh story greed, ambition aur ultimate power reveal ko explore karti hai

title: Laapata Rajkumar
description: But when enemies close in and his past resurfaces, he must reclaim his power before losing everything, including the one person who stood by him.

title: Re: Zero, Starting Life in Another World [Hindi]
description: After being suddenly transported to another world, Subaru Natsuki and his new female partner are brutally murdered. However, Subaru awakens to a familiar scene, meeting the same girl again. The day begins to mysteriously repeat itself.

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

description: Course Duration: 21 July 2025 - 30 Dec 2025 Validity: 31 Mar 2026 Online lectures. DPPs and Test With Solutions. Exam guidance at our PW Offline centers. In-person support and helpdesk at PW Offline centers. Subjects: EVS, Mathematics and English.

title: Crash Course Geology
description:
In 25 episodes, we’re going to learn about geology—the study of Earth’s physical structure and processes. Our host, Sage, will teach you about the geological forces and cycles that shape our planet’s past, present, and future. 

This content is based on an introductory university-level curriculum. By the end of this course, you should be able to: 

Trace Earth’s development from its earliest periods to its current structure
Understand the forces of plate tectonics and how they shape Earth’s landscape
Describe the formation of geologic elements like minerals, rocks, and gems 
Identify geologic forces and cycles that impact the earth, while dispelling myths about extreme geological hazards
Learn what geology reveals about Earth’s distant past and what it can teach us about our current changing climate
Explore the geology of other planets within the context of Earth’s unique and common qualities and phenomena
Become familiar with different specialities within geology and what different types of geologists do

Key texts cited include:
Marshak, Stephen. 2021. Earth: Portrait of a Planet, Seventh Edition.
Babcock, Loren E. 2009. Gemstones and Precious Metals.

title: Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

title: Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

title: Scratch in Hindi
description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.

title: Car God Returns
description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

title: The Teen Queen
description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

title: Mission Admission
description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
description: When a brilliant but humble scientist is falsely accused by a fame-hungry influencer, he must fight a ruthless social media trial, powerful enemies, and public humiliation to reclaim his name and complete a mission that could change India's future.

title: Dil Ka Encounter
description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

title: The Return of the Ultimate Mom
description: Watch this show live on KuKuTV now!

title: Pyar ka Turbulence
description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger [Hindi]
description:
A fearless delivery girl’s good deed spirals into an accidental marriage with a man she believes to be penniless—unaware he’s heir to a billionaire empire.
As family secrets, jealous rivals, and office politics threaten her dreams, she must fight for dignity, ambition, and love.
A tale of hidden identities, chaotic matchmaking, and an unexpected romance that could change her life forever.

title: Codename Pyaar
description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

title: Beghar Billionaire
description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

title: Time Travel [Hindi]
description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Rahul mysteriously travels back in time, determined to change his fate, save his family, and protect Alia from powerful enemies only to discover that altering the past comes with dangerous new consequences. Watch Now!

title: The Richest Bank Robber
description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

title: Social Media ka Billionaire
description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions [Hindi]
description: "Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions" A wealthy young heir sets out to “audition” potential father figures to inherit his fortune. As eccentric candidates compete for the role, hidden motives, heartfelt bonds, and unexpected twists blur the line between family and fortune.

title: Oops, It Was My Husband [Hindi]
description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

title: My Accidental Royal Husband [Hindi]
description: In a twist of fate, a common woman accidentally marries a royal heir, unaware of his true identity. As she navigates palace intrigue and royal duties, their bond deepens, leading her to discover unexpected love and power.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: Just Divorced
description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

title: Brahmrakshas
description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

title: Paralysed Dulha [Hindi]
description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.

title: My Commando Wife
description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

title: The Miracle Surgeon
description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

title: Ruthra Thandavam
description: Ruthra Thandavam

title: Mafia's Innocent Bride [Tamil]
description:
Don David rules the dark underworld of Chennai. His word is law, his eyes spell death.

When Meera is pulled into his ruthless world, she faces blood, betrayal, and revenge at every turn.

The throne of power is up for grabs. The war has just begun. 🔥

Every moment a riddle. Every scene a shock. Witness it Now!

title: Me and My Sister [Tamil]
description: ஒரு போர்ல நல்லா அனுபவப்பட்ட ஒரு சோல்ஜர், ஒரு அழகான, பவர்ஃபுல் CEO-க்கு பர்சனல் பாடி கார்டா மாறறான். மறைஞ்சிருக்கும் ஆபத்துல இருந்து அவளைக் காப்பாத்துறான், அதே நேரம் பெரிய சதித்திட்டங்களையும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். இந்த குழப்பத்துக்கு நடுவுல காதல் மலர, அவனோட பலமும் விசுவாசமும் கொடூரமான எதிரிகள், அப்புறம் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிக்கு எதிரா சோதிக்கப்படுது..அந்த சோதனையில இருந்து தப்பிச்சானா??

title: Battle of Billionaire  [Tamil]
description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

title: Rented Husband [Tamil]
description: Rented Husband

title: My Fiancé Is A Bigshot
description: Divya returns to Chennai hiding her true identity. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by her lover Guru, she is pushed to the edge. A chance encounter with Kishore, a powerful CEO fighting his own battles, changes everything. When Divya’s real strength is revealed, those who mocked her are left helpless. This is the rise of a true Lady Boss.

title: After divorce, my wife become a trillionaire [Tamil]
description: Time Travel and historical movie . After a bitter divorce, a man watches in shock as his ex-wife rises to become a trillionaire overnight. Now, the tables have turned—and so has the game of love, power, and regret.

title: Rocket Tycoon [Telugu]
description: A man learns a woman has last-stage lung cancer and needs treatment within three days. A misunderstanding makes her think he is the patient, leading her to panic over money, insult him, and end the relationship. After a time jump, a young scientist wins a major award, but a powerful businessman and his son disrupt the ceremony, forcing the man to intervene and assert his influence.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Telugu]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: The CEO Son-in-Law
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Mom is not Ugly [Telugu]
description: A self-sacrificing mother confronts her ungrateful son and his disdainful family, with help from the man she once saved, leading to a powerful lesson in humility and redemption.

title: The Prince [Kannada]
description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

title: Love Mocktail
description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Kannada]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: Youngest Secret Billionaire [Kannada]
description: A struggling youngster, dismissed by society, dares to dream beyond limits. Through relentless hustle, bold risks, and defying betrayals, he transforms his failures into steppingstones. Against all odds, he rises from anonymity to shocking the world as the youngest secret billionaire, a tale of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled. Watch now.

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [Hindi]
description: Reborn as nobility with the power to size up talent in a glance, Ars Louvent is on a mission to elevate his new life.

title: PSYЯEN [Hindi]
description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "Psyren." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins-one that will change his fate forever.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

title: A Gesture and a Word
description: At age 50, musician and poet, Rob Morsberger was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer - and it came at the high point in his career. After 25 years in the music business, critics were starting to compare his songwriting to Randy Newman, Tom Waits and even Stephen Foster. Finally, it was all starting to come together. Rather than succumb to the shockingly grim news that he had 18 to 20 months to live, Rob used it as fuel to launch into the most prolific period of his songwriting career - determined to utilize whatever remained of this physical and spiritual resources to explore through words and music the nature of life, the inevitability of death and the infinite magic in the detail of a single moment. This musical legacy was for all to hear but it was especially for his 8 year old son so he could know and remember his father. "A Gesture and a Word" is a gentle portrait of the greatest songwriter you never heard of - a man who exemplified the phrase, Ars Longa - Vita Brevis (Art is Long - Life is Short).

Winning the election not only gives them the possibility for power and respect, but guarantees them a future in Kenyan society. Magdalene, has to prove herself in a boy dominated school which has never been led by a girl. She has the impossible task to unite all girls in her fight for equal rights. Harry, from a poor family, hopes to win so he can take care of his family in the future. He struggles against the popular Said who is a natural born leader with a disarming smile.

title: A Moment, A Kiss, A Forever Love
description: After a divorce triggered by her husband's infidelity, Jessie Rowe forms a bond with Erickson Gray, a model, hoping to fulfill her greatest desire—a child of her own. What she doesn't realize is that Erickson, the man she believes she chose, has secretly admired her for years and orchestrated their meeting. Just as Jessie begins to develop feelings for Erickson, her vengeful ex-husband makes a move to complicate things.

title: A Kill for a Kill
description: A deceptive motivational speaker becomes entangled in a deadly game with a fan who suggests they kill each other's spouses.

title: A színésznö és a halál
description: Young actress Kathleen Gáti recalls the eight months - filled with love, suffering, understanding and acceptance - during which she cared for her dying mother. An uplifting and moving spiritual journey from despair to reassurance. Director Gábor Dettre and his then-wife Kathleen Gáti, an actress, talk in a forest about the eight months Kathleen spent caring for her dying mother.

title: A Whale of a Tale
description: Young Joey wants to be an animal trainer so badly that he sneaks into off-limits areas of Marineland.

title: A Concerto Is a Conversation
description: A virtuoso jazz pianist and film composer tracks his family's lineage through his 91-year-old grandfather from Jim Crow Florida to the Walt Disney Concert Hall.

title: A Bullet for a Stranger
description: A mysterious gunfighter decides to protect a pair of naive brothers after they unwittingly clash with a gang of extortionists.

title: A Wing and a Prayer
description: An air traffic controller guides a disabled plane.

title: A House Is Not a Home
description: Ben (Webb) and Linda Williams move the family into a dream home in a last ditch effort to save their troubled marriage. Despite their good intentions, they cannot shake the feeling that they are being watched by something. Their unimaginable fears are realized when things inside the house take a supernatural and sinister turn. Ben and his family flee for their lives, but it is too late. The house isn't finished with them, trapping the family in its labyrinth. The Williams must come together as never before to fight for their family, their lives and to escape.

title: A House on a Hill
description: Harry is an irascible, aging architect trying to achieve the dream of building his masterwork. A wealthy young couple has commissioned Harry to design and rebuild a house he once owned that had burned down. Though reluctant at first, he eventually takes on the assignment and develops a new sense of purpose when his ex-wife Mercedes gives him her blessing. Harry soon realizes that the work has tapped into the vigor and promise of his youth. In the meantime Gaby has been hired to make a documentary about Harry--her project helps to reveal a complex man who, because of personal tragedy, has never attained the greatness most people felt he was destined for.

title: A Tale of a Naughty Girl
description: Based on a short story by Bengali writer Prafulla Roy, the central idea developed by director Dasgupta, tells the story of a girl, Lati, whose mother Rajani is a prostitute living and working in a brothel in rural India. Rajani plans to offer her daughter to an older man, a rich husband and protector to her daughter. Lati, however, wants to return to school and finish her studies. Unwilling to pay such a price for material success, she runs away to Calcutta. The discovery of this new world is described parallel to other stories of emancipation, such as that of three young prostitutes, of an aged couple going nowhere and man's n landing on the moon. In a surrealistic approach typical of the director, a clumsy cat and an intelligent donkey are also present in the film.

title: A Man with a Maid
description: A Victorian aristocrat buys a former madhouse and converts it into a "love nest". Unknown to him, Jack the Ripper lives in secret passages lining the building.

title: A Bridge to a Border
description: When a man crosses a bridge, he faces a border. Pakal Gomez, ex- border patrol officer, railroaded into prison for a crime he did not commit, turns to terror as the last chance to wake up America. A gripping character study of rebels with and without a cause...

title: A Flecha e a Farda
description: The documentary begins with the 2012 discovery of silent registers of members of the GRIN (Rural Indigenous Guard) parading in uniform in 1970. It proceeds as an investigation into this all-indigenous militia group, founded and trained by Brazil's most recent military dictatorship, whose ranks were never formally dissolved. From study of archival material and present-day meetings with former GRIN members and their families unfolds a bifurcated reflection on the legacy of the dictatorship and the place of indigenous people in Brazilian society, one in which past and present hold equal weight.

title: A Night at a Honeymoon
description: Gaston wants more than anything to marry the naive Simone. But where he is, there is Sidonie, a local singer romantically pursued by the police commissionaire.

description: The NBAs #1 Draft pick Malik Hall is town. Eli is the neighborhood street ball legend. Looking to prove his toughness, Malik sees beating Eli as a way to prove himeself. When these two ball players collide and one of them wont make it.

title: A Cura
description: A young medical doctor discovers some paranormal abilities. He can operate people with the assistance of the spirits of dead people.

title: A Family

title: A Beggar? A Miracle Doctor!

title: A Road to a Village
description: A road constructed in a village brings development, opportunities but at some cost.

title: A Wedding, A Forgotten Debt
description: Three years ago, Martha Hale’s husband and son died saving everyone in their building during an earthquake. But neighbor Rita Kerr soon forgot their sacrifice and even saw Martha as “bad luck.” Now, as Rita’s son Dylan Crowe prepares for his wedding, Martha decides to make everyone face the truth: honoring the dead means honoring life, and gratitude should never be forgotten.

title: A Bargain for a Bargain
description: The life of the twin brothers Kashkin has developed in different ways: one lives in the capital and has quite succeeded as a fashionable - bathhouse attendant. The other remained in his native village as a simple fishery inspector.

title: A Herdeira vs. A Falsa
description: Ela e o namorado estavam em um relacionamento à distância há quatro anos. Após o ensino médio, ela foi estudar no exterior e, para que ele não se sentisse inseguro com sua origem modesta, manteve em segredo o status de sua família rica, fingindo vir de uma família comum e alegando que estava estudando fora com empréstimos estudantis. Durante os quatro anos separados, ela sempre acreditou no amor dele por ela. No entanto, em uma reunião de volta para casa, ela o viu de braços dados com a filha adotiva de sua família, e naquele momento, suas ilusões se desmancharam. A filha adotiva estava usando o nome da família em benefício próprio, posando como a verdadeira herdeira. Na reunião, ela e um grupo de colegas a zombaram e humilharam, mas a verdadeira herdeira não estava mais se escondendo—ela chamou os três irmãos, que rapidamente colocaram todos em seus lugares.

title: The New Americans: Gaming a Revolution
description: "THE NEW AMERICANS: Gaming a Revolution" is a visceral, meme-driven journey into the intersection of finance, media, and extremism to look at the explosive and irreversible ramifications of our digital future.

title: B2: Stealth at War
description: The most expensive and specialized airplane ever built, the B2 Stealth bomber carries a price tag of more than two billion dollars. Highly effective and extremely technically advanced, it has been an integral part of the Air Force arsenal for the past 20 years. From a Cold War scrap heap candidate, to the go-to bomber in the 2011 strike against Qaddafi's army in Libya, "Spirit" has seen its share of trials and triumphs. Join us as we detail how this secret weapon evolved to overcome critics, espionage, and even tragedy, to change the shape of aviation forever.

title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!

title: A Girl Named C
description: A sensitive examination of child sexual assault, based on the case of a girl who was raped in her New Jersey elementary school by another eleven-year-old student.

title: My Boss
description: Founder of Jun Heng Law Firm, Qian Heng, and rookie lawyer, Cheng Yao, go from boss/employee to landlord/tenant in a shared house. They began to rub off on each other in terms of work, life, habits and principles and began to fall in love.

title: Me & Mrs. C.
description: A young black female ex-convict becomes a boarder with the elderly white Mrs. Conklin in an effort to turn her life around. The two women take to each other immediately as the show chronicles their adjustments to and episodes with each other.

title: Love Between Fairy and Devil
description: A fairy whose tribe was in war with Moon Demon Lord, Qingcang meets him and mutual incantation and mutual curse ties their lives.

title: Ancient Lords
description: Time traveler Meng Qi only wants to be a merry and graceful swordsman, but he suddenly becomes the world-renowned "Mad Monk" in accomplishing his repeated and unlimited mission in the "reincarnation space". However, all this turns out to be planned by a powerful ancient lord. The story tells how the invincible and funny monk makes his way around in the world of martial arts and becomes a legendary swordsman.

title: The Best of Studio C
description: A collection of the Best of Studio C. Come watch your favorite cast members in their greatest and funniest sketches. Playlists are organized by theme, such as Best of Christmas and Best of Back to School.

title: You Are My Secret
description: Lobby manager Xiao Ning and business star Yu Heng share a desire to marry soon. As childhood friends turned colleagues when Yu Heng becomes Xiao Ning's boss they navigate marriage and career together exploring life's meaning as newlyweds.

title: Country Girl，CEO’s Wife.（Dubbed）
description: Olivia Charles is a young woman from the countryside who comes to the city to work. On her first night in the city, she is maliciously set up by her fellow villager Sabrina and, by accident, ends up having a one-night stand with a  billionaire, Chandler Harrision. Because neither of them saw each other's face clearly, Sabrina pretended to be Chandler Harrision's girlfriend, hoping to marry into wealth. Olivia, relying on her own abilities, successfully lands a job as a housekeeper at the Chandler Harrision's hotel, and accidentally discover that the man she had a one-night stand with is her new boss. Olivia then finds out she is pregnant with his child, making matters more complicated.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: Enceinte des Triplés du Roi Dragon (Doublé)
description: Vendue par sa famille à des prétendants violents contre de l'eau magique, Amélie, servante renarde que l'on croyait stérile, tombe enceinte de triplés après une nuit avec un inconnu qui est en réalité le Roi Dragon, Édouard. Tandis qu'il la protège de sa famille, de ses rivaux et de collègues jaloux, une attaque destinée à la tuer révèle qu'elle est la princesse perdue du Clan des Loups à Neuf Queues. Les ennemis tombent ; Édouard la fait sienne comme reine.

title: The Princess and the Werewolf
description: Princess Qipa wakes up to find herself abducted. She is forced into becoming the bride of the Beast-Turning King, Kuimulang . Despite Qipa's repeated attempts to escape, her life is further disrupted. of the Beast-Turning Tribe.

title: Ruling Over All I See (DUBBED)
description: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

title: (Doublage) LA BELLE ET LE GARDE
description: (Doublage) LA BELLE ET LE GARDE

title: [Doublé]Sous le Sceau du Pouvoir
description: Estelle Marin et Édouard Valois, confrontés à des conflits de pouvoir et d'émotion, se retrouvent dans un jeu politique complexe. Face à la tyrannie de l'empereur, Estelle s'allie avec le Prince Louis Valois pour renverser le régime et sauver le royaume, tout en naviguant à travers des luttes émotionnelles intenses.

title: The Monk and the Gun
description: An American travels into Bhutan in search of a valuable antique rifle and crosses paths with a young monk who wanders through the serene mountains, instructed by his teacher to make things right again.

title: Billionaire CEO Encounter
description: The bride price negotiation collapsed on the spot after pulling a strange man to get married, also thought that the other party is a lobby manager, after the marriage found that he is actually hidden the richest man, was put in his heart tip favor!

title: Zero: The Devouring God
description: Mechanic Arthur awakens scrapped mech Zero. Hunted by the Empire, Zero evolves by devouring. After Arthur is nearly killed, Zero awakens emotions, becomes a true god, and devours the Genesis Mind—resetting the universe. Zero is reborn as a human girl.

title: [Dubbed]He Is More Than a Driver
description: Colin loves his wife Myra. Yet Myra only cares about her career, so much so that she grows close to her ex for the sake of investment. After all, Colin is just a broke driver. He’s no help to her. But who knows Colin is actually a financial mastermind. He only gave up his empire for love, and not until their divorce does Myra learn this...

title: When Marnie Was There
description: Anna, a shy 12-year-old girl, is sent to spend time with her aunt and uncle who live in the countryside, where she meets Marnie. The two become best friends. But Anna gradually discovers that Marnie is not quite who she appears to be.

title: Died at Work, Got a Family (English-dubbed)
description: Adrian Vale, a worker at Elixir Works in the Immortal Realm, dies in a car accident, only to be reincarnated in the body of Henry, the neglected eldest son of the Lynch family. Once a bitter man mistreating his wife and in-laws, Henry is now touched by the warmth and care he receives. Inspired by this newfound love, Adrian, a thousand-year seeker of immortality, decides to lead his family on the path to power and eternal life.

title: Non-Renewed
description: One act of retaliation reveals a very big secret.

title: Imprisoned 2: There Is No Escape from Fate
description: Wrongfully imprisoned in a brutal multinational prison, a Hong Kong businessman must escape the sadistic warden's torture to survive.

title: Uncovering Truth: The Prejudice Of Perjury
description: Team of Investigators seek to uncover the truth behind the shocking sex scandals of Hollywood and abroad. And seek to define the truly guilty.

title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
description: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: Looking for Infinity: El Camino
description: The film offers an intimate and fascinating insight into the pilgrim's journey, seeking to probe some of the timeless questions confronting humanity.

title: Tininti del barrio
description: The most delightful rip-roaring, comedy of the year.

title: Men in Black: International
description: The Men in Black have always protected the Earth from the scum of the universe. In this new adventure, they tackle their biggest threat to date: a mole in the Men in Black organization.
